verdict.rationale: Docs show mise's aqua/github/ubi backends fetch prebuilt binaries with verified signatures (mise-docs-14/37/46, mise-docs-57), and community reports confirm it replaces manual GitHub-release binary downloads (mise-comm-14), implying no from-source compilation for these tools. However, no evidence explicitly describes a local binary cache mechanism or cache-hit behavior — missing for 10: explicit cache documentation, cache location/config, and confirmation that repeated installs reuse cached binaries rather than re-downloading.
